# Differential Expression: Volcano Plots and DEG Contrasts

High-throughput transcriptomics and proteomics evaluate thousands of features simultaneously. Volcano plots and contrast matrices map effect size ($\log_2\text{FC}$) against statistical significance ($-\log_{10}P$).

## Volcano Plots: `type = "volcano"`

A volcano plot places $\log_2(\text{Fold Change})$ on the horizontal axis and $-\log_{10}(P\text{-value})$ or $-\log_{10}(\text{FDR})$ on the vertical axis:

$$\text{Significance Quadrants}: \begin{cases}
\text{Up-regulated}: & \log_2\text{FC} \ge \tau_{\text{FC}} \quad \text{and} \quad -\log_{10}(P) \ge \tau_P \\
\text{Down-regulated}: & \log_2\text{FC} \le -\tau_{\text{FC}} \quad \text{and} \quad -\log_{10}(P) \ge \tau_P \\
\text{Non-significant}: & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}$$

## Contrast 1: Atopic Dermatitis vs. Control Skin (NCBI GEO GSE121212)

Using the bundled dermatology series dataset (`geo_dermatology_series_de.rds`), we evaluate lesional skin from patients with Atopic Dermatitis (AD) against Healthy Controls (HC):


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(cliomicplot)
library(ggplot2)

data_file <- system.file("extdata", "geo_dermatology_series_de.rds", package = "cliomicplot")
series <- readRDS(data_file)

# Inspect available contrasts
names(series)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] "ad_vs_hc"       "pso_vs_hc"      "ad_vs_pso"      "treatment_meta"
[5] "series_tidy"   
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
# AD vs. Healthy Control volcano plot
ad_labels <- c("SERPINB4", "CCL18", "S100A7", "LCE3A", "SPRR2G", "ALOX15", "GPLD1", "SPTLC3")

p_ad_volc <- cliplot(
  -log10(padj) ~ log2FC,
  data = series$ad_vs_hc,
  type = type_volcano(
    pval_cutoff  = 0.01,
    fc_cutoff    = 1.5,
    point_size   = 1.8,
    point_alpha  = 0.60,
    label_genes  = ad_labels,
    max_overlaps = 25
  ),
  palette  = "nature",
  preset   = "nature",
  title    = "NCBI GEO GSE121212: Atopic Dermatitis vs. Healthy Skin",
  subtitle = "Bulk RNA-seq | FDR < 0.01, |log2FC| > 1.50"
)
p_ad_volc
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](07-differential-expression_files/figure-html/volcano-ad-demo-1.png){width=2400}
:::
:::


Biological observations:
- Marked upregulation of Epidermal Differentiation Complex (EDC) genes (*LCE3A*, *SPRR2G*, *S100A7*) and Th2 chemokines (*CCL18*, *SERPINB4*).
- Selective downregulation of ceramide biosynthesis enzymes (*SPTLC3*, $\log_2\text{FC} = -0.57$).

## Contrast 2: Psoriasis vs. Control Skin (GSE121212)

Evaluating Psoriasis (PSO) lesions from the same cohort captures the contrasting IL-23/Th17 antimicrobial signature:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pso_labels <- c("DEFB4A", "DEFB4B", "PI3", "S100A8", "S100A9", "SPRR2A", "KRT16", "NOS2")

p_pso_volc <- cliplot(
  -log10(padj) ~ log2FC,
  data = series$pso_vs_hc,
  type = type_volcano(
    pval_cutoff  = 0.001,
    fc_cutoff    = 2.0,
    point_size   = 1.8,
    point_alpha  = 0.60,
    up_color     = "#D73027",
    down_color   = "#2B6CB0",
    ns_color     = "#C8CCD4",
    label_genes  = pso_labels,
    max_overlaps = 25
  ),
  preset   = "nature",
  title    = "NCBI GEO GSE121212: Psoriasis vs. Healthy Skin",
  subtitle = "Bulk RNA-seq | FDR < 0.001, |log2FC| > 2.00"
)
p_pso_volc
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](07-differential-expression_files/figure-html/volcano-pso-demo-1.png){width=2400}
:::
:::


Key features:
- Massive induction of beta-defensins: *DEFB4A* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +10.00$, $P_{\text{adj}} = 2.02 \times 10^{-75}$) and *DEFB4B* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +9.49$).
- Elevated calprotectin subunits (*S100A8*, *S100A9*) and elafin (*PI3*).

## Contrast 3: Head-to-Head Divergence (AD vs. Psoriasis)

Directly contrasting AD against Psoriasis isolates disease-specific markers:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
head_labels <- c("ALOX15", "CCL18", "COL6A6", "COL4A4", "NOS2", "DEFB4A", "DEFB4B")

p_head <- cliplot(
  -log10(padj) ~ log2FC,
  data = series$ad_vs_pso,
  type = type_volcano(
    pval_cutoff  = 0.001,
    fc_cutoff    = 1.5,
    point_size   = 1.8,
    point_alpha  = 0.60,
    up_color     = "#E64B35",
    down_color   = "#3C5488",
    ns_color     = "#C8CCD4",
    label_genes  = head_labels,
    max_overlaps = 25
  ),
  preset   = "cell",
  title    = "Head-to-Head Divergence: AD vs. Psoriasis",
  subtitle = "GSE121212 | Positive = AD Enriched, Negative = Psoriasis Enriched"
)
p_head
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](07-differential-expression_files/figure-html/volcano-head-to-head-1.png){width=2400}
:::
:::


Selective discrimination:
- *ALOX15* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +2.72$) and *CCL18* show strong preference for AD.
- *NOS2* ($\log_2\text{FC} = -6.60$, inducible nitric oxide synthase) and *DEFB4A* are selectively enriched in psoriasis.

## Multi-Contrast 4-Panel Grid


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(patchwork)

p_a <- cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$ad_vs_hc,
              type = type_volcano(pval_cutoff = 0.01, fc_cutoff = 1.5, point_size = 1.4,
                                  label_genes = c("SERPINB4", "CCL18", "LCE3A", "SPTLC3"),
                                  max_overlaps = 15),
              preset = "nature", title = "AD vs. Healthy")

p_b <- cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$pso_vs_hc,
              type = type_volcano(pval_cutoff = 0.001, fc_cutoff = 2.0, point_size = 1.4,
                                  label_genes = c("DEFB4A", "PI3", "S100A8", "NOS2"),
                                  max_overlaps = 15),
              preset = "nature", title = "Psoriasis vs. Healthy")

p_c <- cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$ad_vs_pso,
              type = type_volcano(pval_cutoff = 0.001, fc_cutoff = 1.5, point_size = 1.4,
                                  label_genes = c("ALOX15", "CCL18", "NOS2", "DEFB4A"),
                                  max_overlaps = 15),
              preset = "nature", title = "AD vs. Psoriasis")

p_d <- cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = series$treatment_meta,
              type = type_volcano(pval_cutoff = 0.01, fc_cutoff = 0.5, point_size = 1.4,
                                  label_genes = c("TK1", "AQP3", "TOP2A", "ECT2"),
                                  max_overlaps = 15),
              preset = "nature", title = "Treatment Meta-Analysis")

((p_a | p_b) / (p_c | p_d)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
```
